_comment: Next-season poll choices beyond the 40 research areas in areas.json. These name an actor or a value no past resolution has been filed under, so they appear in the poll only, never in the Research Areas explorer. `sections` orders the whole poll: every area here and every area in areas.json sits in exactly one section.

areas.name: AI Regulation & Safety
areas.description: Licensing, safety testing or liability for frontier AI models.

areas.name: AI, Automation & Work
areas.description: Job displacement, AI in schools and workplaces, a robot tax.

areas.name: UN as Actor
areas.description: The United Nations should… (Security Council reform, peacekeeping mandates, UN treaties).

areas.name: NATO as Actor
areas.description: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization should… (expansion, burden sharing, Article 5).

areas.name: China as Actor
areas.description: The People's Republic of China should… (Taiwan, Belt and Road, emissions).

areas.name: Middle East States as Actor
areas.description: Saudi Arabia, Iran, Türkiye or the Gulf states should… (normalization, oil output, nuclear program).

areas.name: Israel as Actor
areas.description: The State of Israel should… (two-state solution, settlements, Gaza, normalization).

areas.name: European Union as Actor
areas.description: The European Union should… (enlargement, AI Act, common defense).

areas.name: India as Actor
areas.description: The Republic of India should… (Quad, non-alignment, climate commitments).

areas.name: Individual Liberty vs. the Common Good
areas.description: When they conflict, individual freedom ought to be valued above collective welfare.

areas.name: Civil Disobedience & Resistance
areas.description: Civil disobedience in a democracy is morally justified.

areas.name: Justice, Punishment & Forgiveness
areas.description: Retribution ought to be valued above rehabilitation; forgiveness as a duty.

areas.name: Wealth, Consumerism & the Good Life
areas.description: The pursuit of wealth is a worthy goal; consumerism does more harm than good.

areas.name: Patriotism, Nationalism & Global Citizenship
areas.description: Patriotism is a virtue; we owe more to compatriots than to strangers.

areas.name: Social Media, Technology & Human Connection
areas.description: Social media does more harm than good to human relationships.

areas.name: Animal Rights & Moral Status
areas.description: Animals have moral rights; eating meat is unjust.

areas.name: Duties to Future Generations
areas.description: Present generations have an obligation to sacrifice for future ones.

areas.name: Merit, Desert & Fairness
areas.description: A meritocracy is just; people deserve what they earn.

areas.name: Religion, Faith & Secular Society
areas.description: Religious belief ought to guide public life; secularism and moral values.

sections.label: Critiques & values (no institutional actor)
areas: Individual Liberty vs. the Common Good
